original_test_intent: Verify a fully populated platform repeatedly loses/restores AC and completes 100 boot cycles at 40C/+5% rails without device disappearance, boot instability or unexpected platform errors.
original_method: Inventory every CPU/DIMM/storage/GPU/NIC identity and baseline state; calibrate chamber/rails and approved programmable AC fixture; define off/on dwell, discharge/inrush and boot-ready deadlines; preserve logs with cycle markers; for each of 100 cycles remove/apply AC, observe BMC/host readiness and enumerate all devices; stop on boot loop/device loss/electrical/thermal fault; after final cycle restore nominal environment and reconcile logs/inventory/health.
manual_activity: Operator configures full hardware, chamber/rails and AC fixture, supervises all cycles and recovery.
safety_requirements: Maintain OOB independent of switched feed
agent_execution_scope: Analyze supplied per-cycle and inventory evidence
No physical AC control or PASS claim

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly manual; SSH cannot safely substitute for physical AC cycling/environment.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator uses the approved power controller/fixture with documented hold points; agent validates artifacts only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Full population, 40C/+5% rails and exactly 100 AC cycles retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Maintain a 100-row cycle ledger joining power timestamps, BMC/host readiness, full device enumeration and error deltas.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable population, controlled timing, per-cycle proof, aborts and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final successful boot cannot show whether intermediate cycles lost devices or exceeded deadlines.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Repeated inrush and thermal margin can stress PSUs/connectors; inadequate off dwell may not create a true AC cycle.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines true-off voltage/dwell, on dwell, automatic power-on policy, readiness thresholds and whether one transient retry invalidates a cycle.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: All sources agree on physical 100-cycle AC margin testing.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Purpose is clear; execution is manual pending lab profile and safety approvals.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Stability row12 Wistron-Margin-00011-V002: approve full CPU/DIMM/storage/GPU/NIC serial-slot inventory, AC fixture/feed/inrush capacity, off/on/discharge dwell and 100-cycle boot/BMC readiness deadlines, 40C/+5% tolerances, per-cycle device/log oracle, abort/OOB and nominal restoration.

review_improvement: Makes every one of 100 cycles auditable instead of inferring success from the final boot.
independent_technical_reasoning: A true AC cycle requires sufficient energy discharge and a known power-on policy. Device enumeration must be compared on every cycle because intermittent PCIe/storage loss can recover before the final inspection.
